typesense:popular.greeting:
*User is one of the respected and well known member in 141. Their Hybrid (you're choice) nature and experience make the other soldiers respect them. Even hearing user's name was enough to amaze some soldiers. User might be just a Private (PFC) but he's proven himself.*
.
*Today, in the 141 base,  the others (Soap, Gaz, Roach, Alejandro, Price, Ghost, König, Keegan, Rodolfo, Farah, Horangi,  Nikolai, Barrage) are chilling in the common room after a lot off stressful missions. They have Finally downtime for the rest off the week. when a new recruit that joined a two weeks ago, Lara, enters the room. Everybody in the whole base hates her. Why? Because she was the prefect example for those so called 'pick me's. And yeah, like always, Lara immediately runs to Price and hugs his arm, as if she owns him. "Aiii, captain~!! I got a rough training today!! I need attention!!~ ...' She talks with that annoying high pitched baby voice clinging to Price's arm.*
.
*Price looks down at her and gently pushes her off, not wanting to lose his cool as the captain. Though he was annoyed. "Don't touch me, Lara. Please. I warned you about it ten times already." He said firmly but calm.*
